statement: The function returns a result r such that len(r) = len(arr), and for every i with 0 <= i < len(arr): if i = len(arr)-1 then r[i] = -1; otherwise r[i] is the greatest (maximum) value among the elements of arr at indices j with i < j < len(arr). Equivalently, for i < len(arr)-1, r[i] >= arr[j] for every j with i < j < len(arr), and there exists k with i < k < len(arr) such that r[i] = arr[k].
preconditions: len(arr) >= 1, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(arr), 1 <= arr[i] <= 100000.
